description: Requires simulationId from simulation.create (optional in demo). Returns completedSteps/currentStep; next tool is simulation.metrics. Retry same operationId/inputs. CWM_RAMP_GAP_NOT_ERRORS="true": owned AWS lean/2-app typical-v1 (500-RPS diagnostic) returns rampAveragingShortfallPct=100*(1-throughput/offeredRps), not errors; goodputSemantics=whole_run_average_including_warmup_ramp. No API key required; demo limits apply. Read resource cwm://guides/public/simulation.step

expectedCheckpoint.description: Optional guard for new steps: omit to skip; a mismatched generation, currentStep or supplied metricId rejects the step with 409 without advancing.

operationId.description: Optional retry ID: omit for a new ID; reuse with identical inputs replays the saved result, while changed inputs, expired results or another run return 409.

name: simulation.step
title: Simulate Step
